column1: # The head coach's list of everyone who coaches, the head coach included. Add coaches with scripts/coaches.py add,
# which gives each the next coach number. Numbers are never reused, and rows are never deleted: a coach who leaves
# is set to active: no. Each coach's me is generated from their row here.
# - number: the coach number in every invoice reference (2026-03-490).
# - code: two letters, used only in internal ids.
# - phone, email: printed on this coach's invoices.
# - invoice_start: the next invoice number from the coach's old app (their sequence carries on from it).
